ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Mercury

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your career and your goals. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up home and family.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on relationships and partnerships. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on routine, daily work and health. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on home and family. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your money and what you value. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on rest and your inner life. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
Until {H:1798798554000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on friends and plans for the future. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.
